name: THE PATRONS
note:
Card players above the tabletop, drawn at THREE TIMES SIZE and AREA-AVERAGED DOWN, which is the step that makes a sprite read like Thad rather than like an illustration. Texture 14.41 to 11.32 -- smoother than every other NPC in the game, which sit at 12.45 to 16.50 -- against Thad’s 6.09.
flatten.py is NOT run after decimation: it expands contrast, which multiplies local variance, and pushed the same strip back up to 13.74. It fixes contrast and undoes decimation, so the two must not be combined. The blue-coated man lays his cards down; the right-hand man turns and raises his. They share a band because their arms overlap, so the band alternates: one moves each beat.

sprite.note: A beat: at rest, and every few seconds ONE movement plays. Intervals of 13, 19 and 9 seconds share no factor, so they never fall into a pattern.
